parameter_semantics: target_object selects red_pose for source and held-object relational inputs; destination selects the currently observed red_goal translation in world metres and is the Cartesian action reference; handoff_object selects blue_pose and blue_goal for predecessor context. Scene identifiers are causal intent, not actuator parameters.
output_semantics: Each slot is [TCP position minus observed red_goal position in metres, world TCP rotation-6D, native gripper scalar]. At decode the fresh observed destination translation is added, 6D is projected to SO(3), and supplied Panda IK converts the world TCP pose from freshly measured qpos. The destination frame is axis-aligned because goals expose position only. Slot 0 represents t-1; execution uses slots 1..8 beginning at t. Gripper sign semantics are unchanged.

conversion_check.description: Compare decoded IK FK TCP with demonstrated commanded TCP after destination translation subtraction/addition. Rotation-6D uses only Gram-Schmidt projection; IK residual and limit diagnostics are reported.

cut_relation: Supervises every action in all assigned segments, including the full 230-240 action place_blue overlap, even though the strongest destination invariant applies to red carry, lowering, release and terminal retreat.
